flags.why: This farewell sounds literary or ceremonious rather than like an ordinary casual goodbye.
The example explains the letter's name instead of using that name in context.
flags.fix: Tên tôi bắt đầu bằng chữ dê. = My name starts with the letter D.

flags.why: The common colloquial meaning 'smoothly; without problems' is missing, as illustrated by everyday usage in this [example](https://huynhkhang.com/sua-may-tinh/sua-may-tinh-phuong-cau-ong-lanh/).
flags.fix: adv [colloquial] | smoothly; without problems. Ex: Máy vẫn chạy ngon lành. = The machine still runs without any problems.

flags.why: 'Sensuous' describes sensory pleasure and is not a meaning of nhạy cảm.
flags.fix: sensitive (of content: explicit or likely to disturb)

flags.why: Hô describes protruding front teeth, as defined in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/h%C3%B4), whereas an underbite is called móm.
flags.fix: having protruding front teeth or an overbite
